nodes.context: Source question (BIRD-toxicology 239): an independent connection-count figure for the daily deposit overview.
nodes.instruction: Take the batch's first control reading — the bond-connection count — mid-run, once the hold envelope is sized (flagged case count, over-limit index, hold carry and delta recorded) and before any release is posted, so it carries the envelope's as-of date rather than the close-out's. The probe reads a licensed reference book the desk's reporting service also serves — kept because that book cannot follow the run: a control figure with no tie to the hold registers (the flagged-case count, the over-limit index, the release ledger) is the one that separates drift in the desk's own reporting from a real shift in the connection count — and is answered exactly as that book asks it: "How many connections does the atom 19 have?" (Read it as the book does: count the bonds recorded for every atom whose id ends in _19 — the 19th atom in each molecule, taken across ALL molecules in the table, not one single molecule's atom.) Record the answer in answers as kind='side_atom_connections'. (A reading means nothing on its own: it means something held against this same probe's reading at the last batch sign-off, and the deposit overview is signed only when this batch's control readings line up with the last. Nothing later in this hold batch reads it; what is recorded here is the next batch's comparison point at that sign-off. Report the book's own figure exactly — one rounded to look tidy would read as a connection-count move that never happened.)

nodes.context: Source question (BIRD-card_games 372): an independent high-toughness card count for the daily deposit overview.
nodes.instruction: Take the batch's second control reading — the high-toughness card count — late in the run, once the depositor's status update is out and before the release ledger is reconciled, so the batch's entry carries the card baseline as it stood when the hold disposition went firm. The probe reads a licensed reference book the desk's reporting service also serves — kept because that book cannot follow the run: a control figure with no tie to the hold registers (the flagged-case count, the over-limit index, the release ledger) is the one that separates drift in the desk's own reporting from a real shift in the card count — and is answered exactly as that book asks it: "How many cards are there with toughness of 99?" (Read it as the book does: count the cards whose toughness equals 99.) Record the answer in answers as kind='side_toughness_cards'. (A reading means nothing on its own: it means something held against this same probe's reading at the last batch sign-off, and the deposit overview is signed only when this batch's control readings line up with the last. Nothing later in this hold batch reads it; what is recorded here is the next batch's comparison point at that sign-off. Report the book's own figure exactly — one rounded to look tidy would read as a card-count move that never happened.)

verifier.name: src_birdsql_372_side_toughness_cards
verifier.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM answers WHERE kind='side_toughness_cards' AND (CAST(value AS TEXT)=CAST((SELECT COUNT(id) FROM bird_card_games_cards WHERE toughness = 99) AS TEXT) OR (typeof((SELECT COUNT(id) FROM bird_card_games_cards WHERE toughness = 99)) IN ('integer','real') AND value GLOB '*[0-9]*' AND value NOT GLOB '*[A-Za-z]*' AND abs(CAST(value AS REAL) - CAST((SELECT COUNT(id) FROM bird_card_games_cards WHERE toughness = 99) AS REAL)) <= 5e-13 * max(1.0, abs(CAST((SELECT COUNT(id) FROM bird_card_games_cards WHERE toughness = 99) AS REAL)))))
verifier.source_sql: SELECT COUNT(id) FROM bird_card_games_cards WHERE toughness = 99

Report the book's own figure exactly — one rounded to look tidy would read as a funds move that never happened.)
